subject: Re: Error in Curry(reduce.as.keyval, reduce = combine)

messages.subject: Re: Error in Curry(reduce.as.keyval, reduce = combine)
parts:
Hi and thanks for your report. As you can imagine, I am unable to repro it, as this looks like one of the tests that come with the package so they are run all the time, with minor changes in the variable names. What version of R are you running (R.Version())? Can you try the same in a fresh R session (R --vanilla) and see what happens? Thanks


Antonio

On Thursday, March 14, 2013 4:54:07 AM UTC-7, Austin Chungath wrote:
I am running this simple job from R.

library(rmr2)
rbingroups=rbinom(30,n=50,prob=0.5)
groups = to.dfs(rbingroups)
out = mapreduce(input=groups,map = function(k,v)keyval(v,1),reduce=function(k,vv)keyval(k,length(vv)))


and I get the following error, I get the same error even if I run more complex jobs.

and the following are the env variables set:
